create_distribution.description: Put CloudFront in front of a website or other HTTP(S) origin. The new distribution gets its own cloudfront.net domain and takes a few minutes to deploy.
create_distribution.name: create_distribution

parameters.description: The host CloudFront fetches content from, such as www.example.com or an S3 website endpoint. A pasted URL is fine; its path becomes the origin path.
parameters.name: origin_domain

parameters.description: An optional folder on the origin to serve from, such as /production.
parameters.name: origin_path

parameters.description: How CloudFront connects to the origin.
parameters.name: origin_protocol_policy

options.label: HTTP only (for origins without HTTPS, such as S3 websites)

parameters.description: How visitors may connect to the distribution.

parameters.description: A name to recognise the distribution by, up to 128 characters.

parameters.description: Which edge locations serve it.

parameters.name: tags
